title: ECOFLOR 2027 – Praha
text: Two hands-on workshops will be offered on the first day of the conference (starting at 10:00). Both are free for registered participants. Spaces are limited, so early registration is encouraged.

title: ECOFLOR 2027 – Praha
text:
Programme

🗓 Preliminary outline — the detailed programme will be announced after the registration deadline.



Wednesday 3 February

09:30–10:00 📝 Morning registration (for workshop participants)
10:00–13:00 🔬 Workshops: “Pollinators for Non-Entomologists” & “Introduction to YOLO and Visual Tools”
13:00–14:00 🍲 Lunch break & 📝 Main registration
14:00–16:30 💼 Networking: Mentoring and collaboration matching
16:30–17:00 🎉 Opening ceremony & welcome
17:00–18:00 🎤 Opening plenary talk (doc. Robert Tropek)
18:00–20:30 🍻 Welcome meet & greet



Thursday 4 February

08:30–09:00 📝 Registration & poster mounting
09:00–10:15 🗣 Oral presentations – Session Slot 1
10:15–10:45 ☕ Morning coffee break & poster viewing (30 min)
10:45–12:15 🗣 Oral presentations – Session Slot 2
12:15–14:00 🍲 Lunch break
14:00–15:30 🗣 Oral presentations – Session Slot 3
15:30–16:30 ☕ Afternoon coffee break & Poster Session I (60 min)
16:30–18:00 🗣 Oral presentations – Session Slot 4
18:00–19:00 🎤 Evening plenary talk (Dr Katherine Baldock)
20:00 🍻 Conference dinner (venue to be announced)



Friday 5 February

09:00–10:15 🗣 Oral presentations – Session Slot 5
10:15–10:45 ☕ Morning coffee break & poster viewing (30 min)
10:45–12:15 🗣 Oral presentations – Session Slot 6
12:15–14:00 🍲 Lunch break
14:00–15:30 🗣 Oral presentations – Session Slot 7
15:30–16:30 ☕ Afternoon coffee break & Poster Session II (60 min)
16:30–18:00 🗣 Oral presentations – Session Slot 8 / ECOFLOR General Assembly
18:00–19:00 🏆 Awards & closing ceremony



Saturday 6 February

🦬 Excursions — two options:

08:30–16:30 Milovice Nature Reserve (European Bison & wild herbivores)
10:00–14:00 Prague (walk through the historical centre with a local guide)

Details to be announced

title: ECOFLOR 2027 – Praha
text:
Plenary Speakers
Two plenary talks will take place during the meeting: one on Wednesday 3 February (17:00) opening the scientific programme, and the other on Thursday 4 February (evening).

title: ECOFLOR 2027 – Praha
text:
Acknowledgements

We are grateful to the institutions that make EcoFlor 2027 possible: the Faculty of Science, Charles University for hosting the meeting, and the Česká společnost pro ekologii (ČSPE) and the Asociación Española de Ecología Terrestre (AEET) for their support and co-organisation.
